title: Insaan Aur Shaitan
overview: Vijay Chauhan (Sanjeev Kumar), an honest security officer, finds his life shattered when he is framed for a train robbery involving a massive shipment of gold. The heist results in a tragic accident that leaves his father blind. Branded a criminal, Vijay becomes a fugitive, hunted by the police and the ruthless "Jwalamukhi" gang responsible for the setup.

songs.title: Teri Ada Ha Ha Meri Wafa Ha Ha
